headline: DeepSeek Flash hits 14.8%, Anthropic's new Opus breaks records
summary: DeepSeek's flash variant surged 2.1 percentage points to claim the top spot at 14.8% token share, while Anthropic's freshly-minted Claude Opus 5 set an all-time high on day 3 of its streak. OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Terra rocketed 19 ranks in a single day, and four new models entered the top 50—including Qwen's latest flash variant at rank 49.
highlights: DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260423 now #1 with 14.8% share (+2.1% in one day)
Anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723 sets all-time record at 2.2% share (day 3 of streak)
OpenAI/gpt-5.6-terra-20260709 vaults 19 ranks to #24 in 24 hours
Four new entrants: InclusionAI's Ling 2.6, Moonshot's Kimi K2.6, Qwen's 3.7-Flash, MiniMax's M2.7
DeepSeek provider share now 22.3% (+2.5% daily); Xiaomi drops 5.6% to 10.1%
Perplexity's embed model plummets 12 ranks; Mistral and Qwen embedding exit top 50
